sections.title: Direct Access for the Global Press
sections.body: Kenya AI Compute is at the center of several major global narratives: the AI infrastructure boom, the growth of the African tech economy, and the rise of sustainable 'Green Compute.' Our media relations team is equipped to provide high-quality information, data-backed insights, and executive commentary for your stories. We offer journalists direct access to our founding team and lead engineers for interviews, as well as high-resolution photo and video assets from our site in Kenya. We understand the tight deadlines of the modern news cycle and aim to respond to all qualified media inquiries within four hours. Whether you're writing a deep dive on DePIN economics or a profile on the East African tech hub, we are here to provide the context you need. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
